name: ToxicIgnition / death

request.text: 4-second dry close game SFX. Immediate loud attack. A muffled gas-cloud ignition whump and a rolling rough flame, followed by sustained hollow toxic-cloud flutter mixed with charred gas pops and weakening fire. Audible evolving tail for 3 seconds; fade only at end. No voice, scream, music, ambience or reverb.
